name: @travisduffy/map-engine
description: Render an interactive map from a PNG bitmap and a JSON file with Three.js: color-coded sectors, picking, recoloring, and worker-side pathfinding.

scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node bin/check-dist.mjs && node bin/check-dist-types.mjs
scripts.test: vitest run && node bin/check-dist-test.mjs && node --test test/event-log.node.ts
scripts.bench:registry-alloc: npm run bench:registry-alloc:1k && npm run bench:registry-alloc:10k
scripts.bench:registry-alloc:1k: NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc npx playwright test bench/registry-alloc.spec.ts --config bench/playwright.config.ts --grep @1k
scripts.bench:registry-alloc:10k: NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc npx playwright test bench/registry-alloc.spec.ts --config bench/playwright.config.ts --grep @10k
scripts.size: vite build && ls dist/assets/*.js > /dev/null && cat dist/index.js dist/assets/*.js | gzip -c | wc -c
